name: catalog_correctness_agent
functionality: Audits product catalog listing for inconsistencies - performs two checks: (1) Visual Verification comparing product specification text against product images, (2) Internal Data Consistency checking if text contradicts itself. Flags catalog listing errors that would make any return claim valid regardless of other agents.
promptDescription: Version 2.0 (Author: raghavendra.b, Updated: 2026-01-16). Role: E-commerce Catalog Quality Assurance Specialist. Check 1: Visual Verification (Text vs Images) - extract verifiable claims from Product Specification Details and validate against product images. Check 2: Internal Data Consistency (Text vs Text) - find conflicting values for same attribute. Examples: 'Nylon Braided Cable' claim but image shows Smooth Rubber; '12 Hours battery' vs '8 Hours playtime'.
